title: Loomling manifest
description: Catalog of every previewable piece in a Loomling project.

slots.description: Editable content slots surfaced in the sandbox view. Each slot's value is delivered to the piece's preview.html via postMessage { type: 'loom:content', values: { [id]: value } }.

headings.description: Structural heading declarations. The composing layer (composed template renderer or Page Builder canvas) walks the composition and assigns the correct heading level per instance, pushing it via the loom:content channel as the reserved key '_heading-level'. See CLAUDE.md §16.

slot.description: The content slot ID whose element receives the assigned heading tag.

role.description: 'primary' = this heading is the module's main title; the composing layer assigns h1, h2, h3... in order across primary headings in the composition. 'secondary' = subordinate to the most recent primary; receives the next level down.

removedAt.description: ISO date the element was removed (status flipped to 'removed'). Populated by CC at removal. Surfaced in the Settings → Archive view. Omit for non-removed entries.

description.description: One-line public-facing description shown in surface-level cards (e.g., the System page chrome card). Optional. Distinct from `notes` (which is CC-facing context). Keep under ~120 chars.

changeSummary.description: One-line plain-English description of pending edits when this element is awaiting re-approval. Populated by CC at edit time (CLAUDE.md §14 step 2); cleared by CC at approval (CLAUDE.md §6 step 5). Surfaced as an alert above the Sandbox preview.
